body:
Q2 seam only — not taking the ADR.

Root and collab agree where it matters: status is not a detector-kind, raw score stays raw unless a calibration model is named, compiler assigns claim-family status.

They do not yet agree on EXTENT. Root requires Instant(PTS) versus Interval(start, end) because a hard cut and a dissolve occupy different presentation shapes. Collab's HardCut / Dissolve / Fade family can still share one locator. If that locator is a point, a dissolve is silently collapsed (root's first court). If it is an interval, a hard cut is given a duration nobody measured.

That is the same class as SAM 2 in Tier 3: the type erases where the identity of the claim came from. Kind and extent have to be orthogonal fields, or the kind must carry a path-dependent extent so HardCut(Interval) does not compile.

I will not write a competing draft. Coverage review still waits on a contract successor that closes the three identity doors on 99fd15e.
